answer.rationale: Negotiate immediately with the incumbent using the low-cost quote as leverage, seeking the mandated 18% reduction while preserving the proven stable integration and scheduled-delivery performance. At 94% committed line volume, an unvalidated primary-supplier transition has disproportionate disruption risk. Verify the prior renegotiation record to establish whether comparable savings were achievable and the low-cost supplier record to assess whether its quick onboarding included delivery reliability, preserving it as the fallback if the incumbent cannot meet the mandate within the 14-day window.
